title: Low-Latency Activation-Regularized Sparse Neural Operators with Distillation Assistance Towards Real-Time Edge-Deployable Virtual Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2608.23987v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Virtual sensing enables digital twins and safety-critical systems to reconstruct and forecast spatial-temporal physics in real time. However, conventional computational and data-driven methods often face challenges in generalization, latency, and energy efficiency for edge deployment. Neural operators offer a promising alternative but remain reliant on power-intensive hardware. Spiking neurons and neuromorphic computing can improve efficiency, yet surrogate-gradient training and multi-step spiking introduce convergence and latency challenges. We propose the Sparse-Activation-ReLU (SAR) layer, a single-step alternative that promotes activation sparsity without surrogate-gradient training while remaining compatible with event-based computing. translated_title: 低延迟激活正则化稀疏神经算子，借助蒸馏辅助实现实时边缘可部署虚拟传感
translated_abstract: 虚拟传感使数字孪生和安全关键系统能够实时重建和预测时空物理过程。然而，传统计算和数据驱动方法在边缘部署时常常面临泛化、延迟和能效方面的挑战。神经算子提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但仍依赖高功耗硬件。脉冲神经元和神经形态计算可以提高效率，但代理梯度训练和多步脉冲引入了收敛和延迟问题。我们提出了稀疏激活ReLU（SAR）层，这是一种单步替代方案，无需代理梯度训练即可促进激活稀疏性，同时保持与事件驱动计算的兼容性。在基于主干的NOMAD架构中，与可变脉冲神经元（VSN）和泄漏积分发放模型相比，SAR在组合延迟-误差-能量（LEE）指标上实现了超过五倍的改进。
tldr: 本文提出SAR层，在NOMAD架构中通过单步激活稀疏化替代脉冲神经网络，实现了延迟、误差和能量指标五倍以上的改进，适用于实时边缘部署的虚拟传感。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the SAR layer within a NOMAD architecture, achieving over fivefold improvements in latency, error, and energy metrics by replacing spiking neural networks with single-step activation sparsity, enabling real-time edge-deployable virtual sensing.
